maker.source: docs/hardware-lab.md §2 and Sources, citing Epson, TM-T88VII Technical Reference Guide, https://files.support.epson.com/pdf/pos/bulk/tm-t88vii_trg_en_reva.pdf

model.source: docs/hardware-lab.md §2 and Sources, citing Epson, TM-T88VII Technical Reference Guide, https://files.support.epson.com/pdf/pos/bulk/tm-t88vii_trg_en_reva.pdf

firmware_qualified.source: Not stated by any seed source: no firmware range is named (docs/hardware-lab.md §2 and §4.2 and the documents it cites). The gate records the range it qualified (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6a, §6b.5).

transport.source: docs/hardware-lab.md §2, citing Epson, TM-T88VII Technical Reference Guide, https://files.support.epson.com/pdf/pos/bulk/tm-t88vii_trg_en_reva.pdf: “Epson's and Star's USB default to a vendor-specific class that needs one” — a driver, which the Sources list repeats as “vendor-class USB”

paper_mm.source: docs/hardware-lab.md §4.2, citing Epson, TM-T88VII Technical Reference Guide, https://files.support.epson.com/pdf/pos/bulk/tm-t88vii_trg_en_reva.pdf: “it is 180 dpi, so it prints 512 dots on 80 mm paper”

dot_width.source: docs/hardware-lab.md §4.2, citing Epson, TM-T88VII Technical Reference Guide, https://files.support.epson.com/pdf/pos/bulk/tm-t88vii_trg_en_reva.pdf: “it is 180 dpi, so it prints 512 dots on 80 mm paper”. Seeded because its width differs from the goldens: it exercises the new-width path

raster_command.source: docs/hardware-lab.md §4.2, citing Epson, ESC/POS reference, GS v 0, https://download4.epson.biz/sec_pubs/pos/reference_en/escpos/gs_lv_0.html: “(4095 on the TM-T88VII)”

raster_max_rows.source: docs/hardware-lab.md §4.2, citing Epson, ESC/POS reference, GS v 0, https://download4.epson.biz/sec_pubs/pos/reference_en/escpos/gs_lv_0.html: “(4095 on the TM-T88VII)”

code_pages.source: Not stated by any seed source: no code page is named (docs/hardware-lab.md §2 and §4.2 and the documents it cites). Receipts print as raster; code pages serve only the §2.1 text fallback (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6b.2).

auto_cutter.source: Not stated by any seed source: the TM-T88VII's cutter is not described (docs/hardware-lab.md §2 and §4.2 and the documents it cites).

cut_command.source: Not stated by any seed source: an auto-cutter is named at most, never which GS V cut it honours (docs/hardware-lab.md §2 and §4.2 and the documents it cites). 1.7.4's partial cut is a baseline, not this device's fact (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6a).

cut_feed_rows.source: Not stated by any seed source: no feed before the cut is named (docs/hardware-lab.md §2 and §4.2 and the documents it cites). It is measured on the device: crate::escpos records why no feed is emitted yet (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6b.5).

status_protocol.source: Not stated by any seed source: the TM-T88VII's status is not described (docs/hardware-lab.md §2 and §4.2 and the documents it cites).

drawer_port_volts.source: Not stated by any seed source: the TM-T88VII's drawer port is not described (docs/hardware-lab.md §2 and §4.2 and the documents it cites).

drawer_pulse.source: Not stated by any seed source: no pin or timing is named (docs/hardware-lab.md §2 and §4.2 and the documents it cites). The pin is the drawer's property and the timings its solenoid's (docs/hardware-lab.md §4.5; ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6a).

supports_raster_arabic.source: A qualification result rather than a datasheet fact: nobody has printed the Arabic goldens on this device (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6a; milestone 5.8.3).
